userVars.all.description: Gives you every variable saved for one viewer. Leave the user settings out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch", "youtube" or "kick". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform.
parameters.userName: Optional. The viewer's name. Cuebot looks it up among viewers it has seen before.

userVars.all.returns: An object with every variable name and its value. Empty when no viewer was found.

userVars.clearTemporary.description: Deletes every temporary user variable (the ones that are not saved), for all viewers.

parameters.platform: Optional. Only clear viewers of this platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for every platform.

userVars.delete.description: Deletes one variable of one viewer. Leave the user settings out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "lastSeen".
parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform.
parameters.userName: Optional. The viewer's name. Cuebot looks it up among viewers it has seen before.

userVars.delete.returns: true when the variable existed, otherwise false (also when no viewer was found).

userVars.deleteForAllUsers.description: Deletes one variable from every viewer at once. Handy to reset a weekly score.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "weeklyScore".
parameters.platform: Optional. Only viewers of this platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for every platform.

userVars.deleteForAllUsers.returns: How many viewers lost the variable.

userVars.get.description: Reads a variable saved for one viewer. Leave the user settings out for the person who triggered the action.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "wins".
parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform.
parameters.userName: Optional. The viewer's name. Cuebot looks it up among viewers it has seen before.
parameters.default: Optional. What to give back when the viewer has no such variable, like 0.

userVars.get.returns: The value, or your default (null if you gave none) when it is missing.

userVars.increment.description: Adds to a number saved for one viewer, like their win count. A missing variable starts at 0. Fails when no viewer can be found.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "wins".
parameters.amount: Optional. How much to add, like 1. Use a negative number to subtract. Leave it out to add 1.
parameters.persisted: Optional. true (the default) saves it so it is still there after a restart; false keeps it only until Cuebot closes.
parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform.
parameters.userName: Optional. The viewer's name. Cuebot looks it up among viewers it has seen before.

userVars.set.description: Saves a value for one viewer, like their favourite game. Leave the user settings out for the person who triggered the action. Fails when no viewer can be found.

parameters.name: The variable name, like "favouriteGame". No spaces.
parameters.value: The value to store: text, a number or true/false.
parameters.persisted: Optional. true (the default) saves it so it is still there after a restart; false keeps it only until Cuebot closes.
parameters.platform: Optional. The viewer's platform, like "twitch". Leave it out for the platform of the trigger.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's id on that platform.
parameters.userName: Optional. The viewer's name. Cuebot looks it up among viewers it has seen before.
